normal.name: atallfrog
normal.text: Still new to slow cinema -- and what I've seen steers a bit more melancholy than most cozy games -- but I was primarily thinking of Nightshift (1981) and Goodbye, Dragon Inn. Both place a big focus on just following people while they do their job in a very meditative way. Maybe First Cow too?

normal.name: Crimson Sun
normal.text: Absolutely -delighted- by the sinister undertones in these games marketed as cozy, which they still are. (No spoilers for Whisper yet pls, I've just started but so far it's the elevated Unpacking experience I've yearned for) As usual, if you've got recs I'm all ears - but Switch only!
